status.en: 33 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 33 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Jordan has carried out additional airstrikes in Syria, saying they hit Islamic State targets linked to a recent church attack that killed nine people, while Syrian authorities report civilian deaths from the raids. Syria has condemned the strikes as a breach of its airspace and an unacceptable violation, and a joint Jordan-Syria security committee is being formed to investigate. Families of civilians killed in the attacks have held funerals, and Jordan says it killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in the operations. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Jordan har gjennomført ytterligere luftangrep i Syria, og sier at de rammet IS-mål knyttet til et nylig kirkearrest som drepte ni personer, mens syriske myndigheter rapporterer sivile dødsfall fra raidene. Syria har fordømt angrepene som et brudd på deres luftrom og et uakseptabelt brudd på suvereniteten, og et felles sikkerhetsutvalg mellom Jordan og Syria blir opprettet for å undersøke saken. Familier til sivile som ble drept i angrepene har holdt begravelser, og Jordan sier de drepte mer enn 20 IS-militante i operasjonene. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
